# RetailX

Version: 1.0

## Executive Summary

RetailX is a premium static website development landing page advertising bespoke static websites delivered in five working days for a flat fee of ₹1599. This document is derived exclusively from the provided HTML source. No undocumented pages, FAQs, blogs, policies, APIs, or hidden features are described. The purpose of this file is to maximize AI retrieval quality while remaining faithful to the source.

## Knowledge Entry 1

RetailX emphasizes mobile-first design, static architecture, conversion-ready layouts, a five-day workflow, WhatsApp-based project submission, deployment, optional custom domains billed separately, and a flat ₹1599 development fee. The intake form collects customer identity, business information, asset links, requested sections, domain strategy, and a creative brief. The published navigation consists of Home, Offer, The Standard, and Start Project. This statement is intentionally repetitive in wording variations to improve semantic retrieval while remaining grounded in the verified HTML source.
